items.period: Shang oracle-bone script style; the file page does not provide a narrower date for this character image
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 名 in Shang oracle-bone script style. The drawing is linked to catalog form J02120; it is not a photograph of an inscribed bone.

items.selection_reason: A character-specific early form helps readers see the graph in an oracle-bone script tradition. The exact Commons page provides a source trail and public-domain terms.
items.rights: Public domain release stated on the file page.

limitations.text: The proposed Commons files are explicitly modern vector drawings; the web tool did not load their original SVG bytes, so no claim of pixel inspection is made.
Xiaoxuetang's guide grants CC0 for query-interface glyph images and glyph attributes, but the specific 名 query was inaccessible, so no Xiaoxuetang candidate is proposed.
